alternatives_rejected.candidate: frontend: latency propagated from a downstream dependency
alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend latency-90 shifted by z=97.82, which is orders of magnitude below recommendationservice latency (z=13110) and diskio deviations (E1); inbound calls to recommendationservice gained errors (0.0->0.1741) and roughly 2x latency (E2), consistent with frontend being a victim.

alternatives_rejected.candidate: productcatalogservice: slow dependency inflating recommendationservice latency
alternatives_rejected.why: The unfiltered all-service metric ranking shows no productcatalogservice deviation among the significant ones (E1); recommendationservice's own span self-time doubled (E2), so the slowdown is local rather than inherited.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the process or workload saturating disk I/O on the recommendationservice pod. Check volume and log-write pressure. If it persists, restart or reschedule the pod onto a healthy node, then confirm that diskio and latency return to baseline.
